scientific_explanation: Ordinary 3-band 8-bit RGB images (PNG/JPEG) contain uncalibrated display color values (0–255) without radar polarizations (VV/VH), calibrated backscatter (gamma0/sigma0 in dB), or a Coordinate Reference System (CRS). The trained UNet_ResNet34 (5-channel SAR dB) and LightGBM_Pixel_Spatial (10-feature SAR dB) models require calibrated georeferenced SAR GeoTIFF (.tif/.tiff) or multi-band SAR (.npz) inputs.

incompatible_models_reasons.unet: Requires 5-channel calibrated SAR dB input [vv_pre_db, vh_pre_db, vv_post_db, vh_post_db, delta_vh_db].
incompatible_models_reasons.lightgbm: Requires 10-feature calibrated dual-pol SAR dB input.
incompatible_models_reasons.log_ratio: Requires calibrated pre-fire and post-fire SAR backscatter (VH or VV).
incompatible_models_reasons.cusum: Requires >= 3 co-registered multi-temporal SAR VH dB scenes.

warnings: No Coordinate Reference System (CRS) or affine geotransform present.
RGB optical channels cannot be substituted for microwave C-band/L-band SAR polarizations.
